description: Liquidity-pull / rug alerts on Base — Burn (liquidity-removal) events on recently-launched DEX pools (the new-pairs watcher's set). POST `{ since?, limit?, dex?, minQuote? }`; each event gives the pool, token, and WETH/USDC amount removed (the rug magnitude). Cross-check the token with /v1/token-safety. Unpaid: free while the caller's IP has free-trial calls left that day (a small daily allowance shared across the trial stalls, no wallet); otherwise returns 402. (PAID x402 service — USDC on Base; the MCP server needs a funded wallet to settle.) Price: $0.003 USD (fixed).

minQuote.description: Only removals of at least this much WETH/USDC

since.description: Only pulls first seen at or after this block

name: liquidity_pulls
